title: Concurrent and parallel programming exercise series
summary: Third-year students complete five exercises on parallel processes, independent computation, synchronization, and code-template modification. The paper compares submissions from 2020-2023 for signs of GenAI influence but reports no explicit AI permission or disclosure rule.

sources.title: Exploring Students Solutions to Concurrent and Parallel Programming Exercises – Impact of Generative AI
sources.evidence_quote: The analysis included five different exercises covering the basis of concurrency through various tasks and scenarios.
